title: Toot gayi aas meri toot gaayi aas
body:
Toot gayi aas meri toot gaayi aas
Akbaro baba hai gaye nehr kinare (2)
Are amma mera qalb jala pyaas ke mare
Haye pyaas ke mare
<<DIVIDER>>
Doobte jaate hai mere dil ke sahare
Abbas bohot kuch se tha zainab ko sahara
Haaey aab koi nahi alame gurbat mei hamara
Tumse to dharas si mujhe mere beradar
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba ka farman hua aab tu mukaddar
Hua aab tu mukaddar
Cheen ke lejayenge ada meri chadar
Tum sharm se khaime mei bhi aye na biradar
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye sheh llaye the jab laasha e qasim ko utha kar
Qatl hua ibne hassan mei hhui be aas (2)
Aaye natum dene ko pursa bhi mere paas
Pursa bhi mere paas
<<DIVIDER>>
Are hota hai aab tere haya daari ka ehsas
Tune mujh mehroomi mei kya shaan ata ki
Haaye kulsum ko tadpayengi taa umer judaai
Aashur ki shab teri wafa nakhsh hai dilpar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Array kya kehke tujhe roye kare nala yeh khwahar
Haaye nala yeh khwahar
Array aab tuhi bata de mujhe aye mere biradar
Asgar ki na jab dekhi gaayi tashan dahani
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine di tassaalli use aane ko hai paani
Re banu e shabbir bohot tumpe thi naadan (2)
Re pyaasi hi magar jayega ab asgher nadaan
Haye asghere naadan
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye ghar ke ujad jaane ka bhi hogaya samaan
Baarat bhatijiki chacha jaayenge lekar
Array is aas mei atthara bars pala tha akbar
Tukde huwa sab hasrato armaan ka kaleja (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai armaan ka kaleja
Kya dekhte hi dekhte hogaya bhayya
Sheh kehte the baaki na alamdaar na laashkar
Array zainab ye badhado alam e dilbar e haider
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh sina zani aur qayamat ka tha girya (2)
Sar peet te the zere alam dilbare zehra
Hai dilbare zehra
Haaye sukhe hue hoton pe tha purdard ye nawha
